senses.gloss: , constr. כָּל (b. h.; כָּלַל) all, every one.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 5a:21">Sot. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה הניח כל הרים וכ׳</he> the Lord passed over all mountains and hills and caused his Presence to rest on Sinai.

<cite ref="Sotah 5a:5">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>ככל</he> <cite ref="Job 24:24">Job XXIV, 24</cite>) <he>כאברהם … בַּכֹּל מִכֹּל כֹּל</he> like Abraham, Isaac and Jacob of whom is written ‘with everything’ &c. (<cite ref="Genesis 24:1">Gen. XXIV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Genesis 27:33">XXVII, 33</cite>; <cite ref="Genesis 33:11">XXXIII, 11</cite>).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:1">Ḥull. I, 1</cite> <he>הַכֹּל שוחטין וכ׳</he> all persons are competent to slaughter &c.; <he>וכוּלָּן וכ׳</he> but all those (mentioned as unfit), if they &c. Ib. 2 <he>ובַכֹּל שוחטין וכ׳</he> and you may slaughter with any cutting tool except &c.
Tem. I, 1; a. v. fr.—דברי הכל the words of all, (it is) the unanimous opinion, all agree.
Bets. 9ᵃ ד׳ ה׳ מותר all agree that it is permitted; a. fr.—אין … כל עיקר not at all.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 1:2:4">Y. Dem. I, 21ᵈ</cite> <he>אינו מפריש כל עיקר</he> he does not set aside at all; a. fr.—Y. Shebi. VIII, beg. 37ᵈ, a. e. <he>לא הכל ממנו</he> it is not in his power to do so, v. <cite ref="E00413"><he>הֵימ־</he></cite>.—<he>כָּל העולם כּוּלּוֹ</he> the whole world.
Ber. 17ᵇ; a. fr.—כל ה־, כל ש־ whosoever, whatsoever.

<cite ref="Gittin 11b:13">Gitt. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>כל האומר תנו וכ׳</he> whoever says, ‘Give you’ (a letter of emancipation &c.), is considered as having said, Take possession (in behalf of the person concerned).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 43b:7">Kidd. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שאין יכולה וכ׳</he> whatever woman is incapable of guarding her letter of divorce, is incapable of being divorced.
Ḥag. 4ᵇ, v. יֵשׁ; a. v. fr.—כָּל שֶׁהוּא whatever it be, i.e. the smallest quantity.

<cite ref="Makkot 17a:12">Macc. 17ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כ׳ ש׳ למכות</he> for punishment with lashes, the partaking of any quantity is sufficient, opp. <cite ref="K00446"><he>כזית</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="G00430"><he>זַיִת</he></cite>.
Shebu. III, 1 ואכל כ׳ ש׳ and ate the least thing; a. v. fr.—כָּל שֶׁכֵּן (abbr. כ״ש) there is every reason that it is even so, i.e. so much the more, a matter of course.

<cite ref="Shabbat 63a:28">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> … <he>אורך וכ״ש וכ׳</he> there is length of life promised and, as a matter of course, wealth and honor; a. fr.—<he>לא כ״ש</he>, v. <cite ref="E00940"><he>הַשְׁתָּא</he></cite>.
